svg.aria-label: GramSetu AI. GOVTECH · LEAD DEVELOPER, TEAM OF 3 · NXTWAVE IDEA2IMPACT. A platform where citizens, inspectors and officials audit public infrastructure. Photo evidence is verified twice: Gemini Vision for context, and a YOLOv8 segmentation model that measures potholes and cracks in cm². Role-based access with JWT, contractor trust scores and map dashboards. Tech: React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, JWT, Gemini, YOLOv8
